scope: Approved5d / plan9: necessary finite reset/hold pairs after accepted EXP067. No parameter scan, input switch, comparator offsets, auxiliary mismatch, new algorithm or tuning.
parameter_provenance: Same EXP067 matched curves and synthetic two-phase factors0.002/0.04/0.002, tracking0(reset)/1(hold), reset targets0. No chip identification, new curve or statistical holdout.

input.formula: x[n]=0.82*sin(2*pi*127*(n mod30720)/30720). Stored one-period double table is the declared source; integer modulo is phase reduction, not a reset at evaluation. No input/PRNG/state pause at block boundaries.

dither: Original independent counter streams 2 and 3, indexed by global conversion n, +/-1 with physical amplitudes1/32 at both preamp summing nodes. Periodic input is independent of declared tags; IID independence is a modeling assumption, not a proven property of SplitMix64/chip PRNG.

budget.comparison: Fixed existing finite tracking horizon; same actual conversions, full30x observations. Static first128 blocks only read/hash reused. No endpoint extension.

preflight.reference: Full32-window EXP067 original-platform streams and EXP062 static degeneration. All words/codes/commits/history checked before long.

verification.long_probe_schedule: First4 windows each listed block and final4:28 windows per physical stream. Restore recorded prior three analog outputs; audit all120 nodes, exact rational readouts and original bank commit.
verification.all_digital_replay: Every online/unit code, every Q22 bank-pair commit, all and selected gates/basis/joint/correlations/zero/hidden/export counters by signed integer arithmetic. All global tags regenerated.
verification.all_physical_replay: Independent expanded recurrence via scipy.signal.lfilter for every stored word and window-boundary history, zero resets. Float tolerance2e-12; threshold-near windows separately native-operation replay from preceding window history; count/report exceptions. Original platform probes separately declared.
verification.independent_scores: Every block: independent full complex FFT and extended-precision MSE/DC, compare common rfft score.

empirical_convergence.coordinates: each coordinate with nonzero selected gate-and-basis support in the three-group interval; unsupported coordinates explicitly listed, not called converged
empirical_convergence.definition: first end of three consecutive nonoverlapping8-block groups with SNDR group mean range<=1dB and each supported effective coefficient group mean range<=0.005. Retrospective offline descriptor only, not online stopping; report subsequent violations and total passing intervals. Does not require positive net benefit and does not prove stationarity.

tail.policy: all latter-half window states; population covariance,8-block group drift and temporal correlations. Per-block actual outputs and net gains retained. No iid confidence interval or eight-state stationary-law claim.

evaluation: All startup and later conversions emitted, every slot advances three histories. Same-dynamic unit no-update net output and same-seed static first128-block online/unit references separately scored; reset vs hold separately paired. Integer four-grid dynamic/static observations and actual old states, full-observation interactions, all finite MSE/residual spectral crosses. No cause/stationarity claim. dB and power means separate.
predictions: Short source must exactly reproduce EXP067 words/codes/Q22 and history within tolerance. Dynamic memory persists through unselected slots. Scalar white-input dither root need not minimize memoryless MSE, but not applied as quantitative two-stage coherent prediction. Extra third support is not a benefit gate. No assumed long ordering or convergence.
freeze: Refuse overwrite. Long requires SAME frozen executable sources as accepted acceleration preflight plus accepted EXP067 full delivery. Freeze protocol, source/core/RTL/tests, nominal delivery and table. All histories/Q22/words/codes/windows saved; no warmup removed, no tuning/extension. Only digital words/state feed accumulation. Preserve all failures/seeds. Local only.
